title: Elon Musk says SpaceX's AI revenue will outpace all its other products by next month
excerpt: Musk also said that Grok would be trained on all SpaceX information, including its employees.
content_html:
Elon Musk has predicted that AI will earn SpaceX more money than its other offerings.

On Tuesday, SpaceX posted a 30-minute all-hands recording on X that CEO Elon Musk held with employees, during which he said AI has become an "extremely important part of SpaceX's future."

"Probably our AI revenue — not probably, definitely — our AI revenue will exceed all other SpaceX revenue probably in September, like next month," Musk said in his speech.

"And will significantly exceed all other SpaceX revenue in the fourth quarter," he said.

The executive then shared his ambitions for the training of Grok, SpaceX's family of large language models.

"We're going to be training Grok on the sum total of all SpaceX information," he said. "So in a way, it'll be trained on you."

He said SpaceX employees would be "the parents of the AI," and it would inherit their thoughts, ideas, and beliefs.

He did not provide details on how Grok would be trained on employees. For instance, Meta rolled out a program in April to train its AI models on its employees' keystrokes, a decision that drew major backlash and has since been paused.

SpaceX went public in a historic IPO in June, propelling Musk to become the world's first trillionaire. The company then rebranded as SpaceXAI after acquiring xAI, and has a series of ambitious AI projects in the works.

For one, SpaceX is planning to launch data centers into space to train and run AI models. Musk said SpaceX is planning to build exclusively with Nvidia, pledging to use only Nvidia's advanced Vera Rubin architecture for its compute.

SpaceX also acquired AI coding startup Cursor for $60 billion in June.

Apart from its AI projects, SpaceX's other commercial offerings include its space launch vehicles like Falcon 9 and Starship, its Crew Dragon and Cargo Dragon spacecraft, and its satellite-network product, Starlink.

The company disclosed in its August 4 second-quarter earnings report that AI generated $2.56 billion of its $7.81 billion in total quarterly revenue. Its connectivity products earned $4.29 billion, and its space products brought in $962 million in the quarter.

content_html_zh:
埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 预测，人工智能将为 SpaceX 带来比其他产品更多的收入。

周二，SpaceX 在 X 上发布了一段 30 分钟的全体员工录音，由首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 与员工共同录制，录音中他表示人工智能已成为“SpaceX 未来极其重要的一部分”。

马斯克在演讲中表示：“我们的人工智能收入可能——不是可能，而是肯定——我们的人工智能收入可能会在 9 月份超过 SpaceX 的所有其他收入，就像下个月一样。”

他表示：“第四季度的收入将大大超过 SpaceX 的所有其他收入。”

随后，这位高管分享了他对训练 SpaceX 大型语言模型系列 Grok 的雄心。

“我们将根据 SpaceX 的所有信息对 Grok 进行培训，”他说。 “所以在某种程度上，它会针对你进行训练。”

他表示，SpaceX 的员工将成为“人工智能的父母”，人工智能将继承他们的思想、理念和信仰。

他没有提供 Grok 如何对员工进行培训的详细信息。 例如，Meta 在 4 月份推出了一项计划，根据员工的击键训练其人工智能模型，这一决定引起了强烈反对，此后已暂停。

SpaceX 在 6 月进行了历史性的 IPO，使马斯克成为世界上第一位万亿富翁。 该公司在收购 xAI 后更名为 SpaceXAI，并正在进行一系列雄心勃勃的人工智能项目。

其一，SpaceX 计划将数据中心发射到太空来训练和运行人工智能模型。 马斯克表示，SpaceX 计划与 Nvidia 独家合作，并承诺仅使用 Nvidia 先进的 Vera Rubin 架构进行计算。

SpaceX 还于 6 月以 600 亿美元收购了人工智能编码初创公司 Cursor。

除了人工智能项目外，SpaceX 的其他商业产品还包括猎鹰 9 号和星际飞船等太空运载火箭、载人龙飞船和货运龙飞船以及卫星网络产品星链。

该公司在 8 月 4 日发布的第二季度财报中披露，季度总收入 78.1 亿美元中，人工智能创造了 25.6 亿美元。 该季度，其连接产品收入为 42.9 亿美元，太空产品收入为 9.62 亿美元。
